description:
Cast a copy of Molten Tide from exile by paying one mana, unpreparing Pyre Rhymer.
Displacer Kitten and Urabrask both trigger.
Resolve the Displacer Kitten ability, flickering Biblioplex Tomekeeper.
Biblioplex Tomekeeper triggers when it enters, preparing Pyre Rhymer.
Resolve the remaining trigger, dealing 1 damage to target opponent and adding {R}.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.
